item.title: シティ、欧州子会社でリスク資産過小評価 「是正措置完了」と説明
item.description:
Tatiana Bautzer Elisa Martinuzzi
［１９日 ロイター］ - 米銀大手シティグループが欧...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シティ、欧州子会社でリスク資産過小評価　「是正措置完了」と説明 10:32 配信

シティバンクのロゴ。2025年12月1日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） Tatiana Bautzer　Elisa Martinuzzi

［１９日　ロイター］ - 米銀大手シティグループが欧州子会社で取引を誤って計上し、リスクを勘案して資産を再評価したリスク加重資産（ＲＷＡ）を約３５０億ドル過小評価していたことが分かった。コンプライアンス（法令順守）の取り組みを続けてきた同行にとって痛手となる。

事情に詳しい関係者２人によると、シティは英国の証券子会社で、自社の統計上の仮定に基づく内部モデルを使って取引を誤って計上していた。規制当局はこの種の取引への同モデルの使用を承認していなかった。標準的なリスクモデルで取引を計上し直したところ、ＲＷＡの額が大幅に膨らんだという。

シティはロイターに対し、今夏に欧州のトレーディング子会社で内部の資本モデルに関する問題を特定したと述べた。その上で「是正措置を完了し、資本を注入して同子会社の資本バッファーを直ちに回復させた」とした。

「同子会社は、一貫して規制上の最低基準を完全に満たしており、持ち株会社や中核の銀行子会社への影響はない」としている。

シティは、リスク管理とデータガバナンスの問題で２０２０年に米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）と米通貨監督庁（ＯＣＣ）から是正を命じられ、４億ドルの制裁金を科された。２４年には、データ管理問題の是正が遅れているとして、さらに１億３６００万ドルの制裁金を科された。シティは、法令順守に取り組み、年内に是正命令解除に向けた書類提出を目指していた。

item.description: [２０日 ロイター] - ２０日の金価格は下落し、一時約１％安となった。堅調なドル相場や米利上げ観測の高まりが重しと...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
金価格1％下落、米利上げ観測の高まり受け　当局者発言注視 10:31 配信

金地金。10月27日、シドニーで撮影。REUTERS/Hollie Adams（ロイター） [２０日 ロイター] - ２０日の金価格は下落し、一時約１％安となった。堅調なドル相場や米利上げ観測の高まりが重しとなっている。投資家は金融政策の先行きを探るため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者の発言を注視している。

金現物は００３５ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前９時３５分）時点で０．４％安の１オンス＝３６０７．４７ドルと、２０２５年９月上旬以来の安値を付けた。その後、約１％安となる３５８６．１４ドルまで下げた。

米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１９日、人工知能（ＡＩ）技術の急速な導入が米経済の供給能力を圧迫し、インフレを一段と押し上げる可能性があり、ＦＲＢは対応を迫られるとの見方を示した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む１２月の米利上げ確率は、２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）が９７．３％、５０ｂｐが２．７％となっている。

item.title: アリババ株主が提訴、スパイ疑惑女性との関係隠蔽と主張
item.description:
Jonathan Stempel
[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 中国の電子商取引大手アリババグループの株主は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アリババ株主が提訴、スパイ疑惑女性との関係隠蔽と主張 10:29 配信

アリババのロゴ。7月17日、上海で撮影。REUTERS/Go Nakamura（ロイター） Jonathan Stempel

[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 中国の電子商取引大手アリババグループの株主は１９日、中国のスパイと疑われる女性との関係を隠して株主を欺いたとして、同社をニューヨークで提訴した。この女性と米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）との関係は、同氏が先週辞任する一因となった。

マンハッタンの連邦地裁に提出された集団訴訟の認定を求める訴状によると、アリババは２０２４年、２５年、２６年の年次報告書で、輸出規制違反やその疑いが事業に悪影響を及ぼすリスクを故意かつ大幅に過小評価し、株価を不当に押し上げたとされる。

株主側は、アリババとシンガポール企業メガスピードの関係を問題視した。メガスピードは中国政府によるエヌビディアの先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体へのアクセスを支援した疑いがあり、同社幹部のアリス・フアン氏はジェンスン氏と交際していた。

株主らは、アリババがメガスピードの主要顧客になっていたとの報道など、アリス氏やメガスピードとの関係を巡る報道により、アリババ株が先週、４日間で１４％下落したと主張。

下落の一因として、エヌビディアのスパイ疑惑を受け、米政府が中国のＡＩ企業による先端プロセッサーの遠隔利用への規制を強化する可能性があるとした１１月１２日付のロイター記事を挙げた。

アリババはコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。同社の呉泳銘ＣＥＯも被告となっている。

エヌビディアもこのスパイ疑惑を巡り、取締役の監督が不十分だったとの主張を含む複数の株主訴訟に直面している。

item.description: [上海 １９日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１９日、中...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マスク氏、テスラ中国工場の増産を約束＝中国国営メディア 10:24 配信

テスラのロゴ。上海のギガファクトリーで4月14日撮影。REUTERS/Go Nakamura（ロイター） [上海 １９日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１９日、中国工場での生産を引き続き拡大していく方針を示した。中国国営中央テレビ（ＣＣＴＶ）傘下のソーシャルメディア、玉淵譚天が明らかにした。

• マスク氏は、中国国際貿易促進委員会の任鴻斌・会長との会談でこのように発言した。

• テスラ幹部のソーシャルメディアへの投稿によると、マスク氏は中国訪問中に上海工場を２０２３年以来初めて視察したほか、南部深圳で開催されたアジア太平洋経済協力（ＡＰＥＣ）関連行事にも出席した。

• 上海工場における今年１─１０月の納車実績は、セダン「モデル３」とＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）「モデルＹ」を合わせて前年同期比２１．４％増の計８１万０８８９台となった。

• 上海工場の現在の年間生産能力は９５万台超。自動車製造に使用する部品の９８％を中国国内から調達し、完成車は欧州、韓国、オーストラリアなどの市場に輸出している。

item.title: 韓国企業、トランプ氏次男支援のロボット企業に1.5億ドル出資計画
item.description:
David Jeans
[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 韓国の複合企業ベース・グループが、トランプ米大統領の次...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
韓国企業、トランプ氏次男支援のロボット企業に1.5億ドル出資計画 10:12 配信

トランプ米大統領の次男エリック氏。1月11日、リヤドで撮影。REUTERS/Hamad I Mohammed（ロイター） David Jeans

[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 韓国の複合企業ベース・グループが、トランプ米大統領の次男エリック氏が支援する経営難の軍用ロボットメーカーに１億５０００万ドルを出資する準備を進めていることが、社内メールで分かった。既に米議会の精査対象となっているトランプ一族との関係を一段と深めることになる。

出資先のファウンデーション・フューチャー・インダストリーズは、銃を携行する「ターミネーター」風のロボット兵士を製造し、エリック氏を最高戦略顧問に起用している。ロイターが確認したサンケット・パタク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の従業員向けメールによると、同社はここ数週間、給与の支払いを停止しており、同社の将来はベースからの資金提供にかかっているという。

パタク氏は１１月８日のメールで、給与支払いの問題について「ベース側の状況を踏まえると、これは時期の問題であり、会社の存続に関わる問題ではない」とした。

ベースの広報担当者は、同社が「人型ロボットの長期的な価値と成長の可能性」を認識し、ファウンデーションへの出資を検討していることを認めたが、それ以上の質問には回答しなかった。

ベースが出資に踏み切れば、トランプ一族と関係のある企業に対する同社の金銭的な利害関係を巡る精査が強まる可能性がある。

民主党の上院議員らは８月の公開書簡で、ベースにトランプ一族との関係を説明するよう要求。同グループが２０２５年にトランプ・オーガニゼーションに支払った２００万ドルが、米国のアルミニウム関税の軽減を得るための働きかけと関連していたのかどうかを問いただした。議員らは、こうした見返りがあれば「トランプ政権の腐敗の甚だしい例」になると述べた。

ベースはロイターへの声明で、議会による精査に関する質問には答えなかった。ファウンデーションとパタク氏はコメント要請に応じなかった。トランプ・オーガニゼーションとエリック氏の広報担当者も回答していない。

ベースは少なくとも１７年からトランプ・オーガニゼーションと取引関係にある。同年、傘下企業の１社がトランプ一族のワイナリー事業「トランプ・ワイナリー」のワインを輸入する契約を結んだ。

地元メディアの報道によると、ベースは２月、米韓の事業提携の可能性を探る会合のため、エリック氏をソウルに招いた。また、トランプ・オーガニゼーションは８月、ベースと提携し、韓国でゴルフ場を建設すると発表した。

item.title: データセンター建設、地域との共生へ年内に行動計画作成＝経産相
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は２０日の閣議後会見で、国内のデータ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
データセンター建設、地域との共生へ年内に行動計画作成＝経産相 10:06 配信

赤沢亮正経済産業相。4月7日、国会で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は２０日の閣議後会見で、国内のデータセンター建設を巡って一部住民から不満の声が出ていることなどを踏まえ「地域との共生や立地促進に当たっての制約といった課題に対し、今年末に政府としてのアクションプランを取りまとめるべく、関係省庁と連携し検討を進めていきたい」と述べた。

赤沢氏は、「特に早期の段階で事業者が地域との丁寧な対話を行っていく必要がある」との考えを示した。米国で電気料金の高騰や大量の水使用などの問題が出ているとの指摘については、送配電網増強のための投資が必要となる場合もある一方、電力需要が増えれば使用電力量あたりの利用者負担が下がる要因となるなど「一概に言えない」と説明。その上で、こうした影響については「各省庁と連携し、引き続き状況を注視していきたい」と語った。

日本たばこ産業（ＪＴ）が１９日、ロシア大統領令により現地法人が一時管理の対象になったことを受け、子会社の支配喪失に伴う損失約１兆３７７０億円を計上すると発表したことについては、個別企業の業績見通しにコメントは控えるとした上で、これまで政府としてロシア側に抗議や撤回要求を行ってきたほか、高市早苗首相もプーチン大統領に日本側の立場を伝えたと説明。他の日本企業についても正当な利益が損なわれることのないよう、関係省庁や企業と連携して政府間協議や情報提供を実施していくとした。

item.content:encoded:
Ｔｅｍｕの中国ＰＤＤ、第3四半期利益が予想超え　販促費削減で 10:02 配信

Ｔｅｍｕ（テム）のロゴ。2025年5月に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Anzar Mehraj　Sophie Yu

[１９日 ロイター] - 通販サイト「Ｔｅｍｕ（テム）」を運営する中国の電子商取引大手ＰＤＤホールディングスが１９日発表した第３・四半期決算は、調整後純利益が市場予想を上回った。販売・マーケティング費用の削減が寄与した。

調整後純利益は３１０億元（４６億５０００万ドル）。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は２８０億３０００万元だった。

販売・マーケティング費用は約１７％減の２５３億元となった。

一方、売上高は前年同期比横ばいの１０８３億元で、アナリスト予想平均の１１５９億７０００万元を下回った。

同社は中国国内で「拼多多（ピンドゥオドゥオ）」、海外向けにテムを運営。アリババグループの「淘宝網（タオバオ）」や「天猫（Ｔモール）」、京東集団（ＪＤドットコム）、字節跳動（バイトダンス）傘下の「抖音（ドウイン）」と、値引きや補助金、優遇策を通じて、消費者や出店者の獲得を競っている。

趙佳臻共同会長兼共同最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、サプライチェーン（供給網）とプラットフォームのインフラに引き続き多額の投資を行うと述べた。

item.title: 日経平均は4％超安、アンソロピックＩＰＯ後の米株安嫌気
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - ２０日の東京市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株を中心に売り...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は4％超安、アンソロピックＩＰＯ後の米株安嫌気 9:55 配信

株価ボードが映し出された電子スクリーンの前を歩く男性。2025年4月、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - ２０日の東京市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株を中心に売りが先行し、日経平均株価は一時４％超安となって約７カ月ぶりの安値水準に下落した。ＡＩ開発を手掛ける米アンソロピックによる新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）での初値形成後に米国市場でＡＩ株が軒並み売られたことを、嫌気する動きが先行した。東証プライム市場では９割の銘柄が売られ、ほぼ全面安の商状となっている。

ソフトバンクグループが一時１５％安、キオクシアホールディングスが１０％安、アドバンテストが９％安、東京エレクトロンが６％安と、ＡＩ株が大きく下落し、指数を押し下げた。

市場で注目されたアンソロピックの上場初日の値動きは、初値が１１１．５ドルと新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の８３ドルを約３４％上回ったが、その後は上げ幅を縮小し１７％高の９７．１７ドルで終了。フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）は、アンソロピックの株価に歩調を合わせるような値動きになり、前日比２．４％安で取引を終えた。

アンソロピックの初値後の利益確定の動きについて、岩井コスモ証券の有沢正一投資調査部フェローは「上場当日の換金売りが出た可能性があるほか、アンソロピックの上場まで（ＡＩ株が）上昇すると踏んで買っていた短期筋による出尽くし売りもあっただろう」との見方を示す。

アンソロピックのＩＰＯは、ＡＩ相場の起爆剤になるとの期待と資金吸収への懸念が交錯していた。ＩＰＯ自体は、終値が公開価格を上回って成功だったとの受け止めが優勢となっている。三井住友トラスト・アセットマネジメントの上野裕之チーフストラテジストは、来週前半ぐらいまでは需給要因もあって不安定になりそうだとの見通しを示すが、資金吸収圧力は徐々に落ち着くともみている。

米中間選挙を経てＡＩデータセンター規制などの議論の行方への不透明感がくすぶる一方、足元のＡＩ関連業種の業績は悪くないとも市場では受け止められている。三井住友トラストＡＭの上野氏は、仮に規制議論が進んでもすぐに業績が悪くなるとは想定していないとして「きょうすぐに、というわけではないとしても、近く悪材料出尽くしになるのではないか」との見方を示している。

item.description:
Takaya Yamaguchi
［東京 ２０日 ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相兼金融相は２０日、楽天証券の情報漏...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
楽天証券に報告徴求命令、顧客情報漏えい「非常に遺憾」＝片山金融相 9:47 配信

片山さつき財務相兼金融相。10月21日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相兼金融相は２０日、楽天証券の情報漏えいを巡り、同証券に対し１９日付で報告徴求命令を発出したことを明らかにした。顧客情報の漏えい事案そのものは「非常に遺憾」とし、「金融庁として非常に重く受け止めている」と述べた。

同日午前の閣議後会見で語った。報告を待って顧客保護に向けた適切な対応と、再発防止の徹底を求める考えも示した。

報告徴求を巡り、片山金融相は「しっかりと確認、検証し、厳正に対応していく」と強調した。

一方、ロシア大統領令により現地子会社が同国企業の一時管理の対象となたった日本たばこ産業（ＪＴ）が１９日、業績修正とともに減配予想を発表したことに伴う影響については「産業投資に直ちに支障が生じることは全くない」とした。

item.title: Analysis:BOJ's ambiguity on rate hike path could tempt yen bears
item.description: TOKYO, Nov 20 : Bank of Japan policymakers mostly agree on the need for an interest rate hike next month, but their split over how far rates should eventually rise risks muddying the outlook and triggering a fresh round of yen selling.BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has struggled at times to get his hawkish signals a

item.content:encoded:

Analysis:BOJ's ambiguity on rate hike path could tempt yen bears

FILE PHOTO: Japanese 10,000 yen and 1,000 yen banknotes are displayed in this illustration taken October 20, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/Illustration/File Photo

20 Nov 2026 08:47AM

FAST

TOKYO, Nov 20 : Bank of Japan policymakers mostly agree on the need for an interest rate hike next month, but their split over how far rates should eventually rise risks muddying the outlook and triggering a fresh round of yen selling. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has struggled at times to get his hawkish signals across to markets, including in December last year, when the yen fell despite the decision then to hike rates. While vague messaging helps the BOJ keep its options open amid heightened economic uncertainty, the lack of clarity on how far the bank could eventually raise rates has also become a particular trigger for yen bears. A board reshuffle next year, which gives Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi a chance to replace two departing hawks with her preferred candidates, may also shift the debate around the terminal rate - now seen by markets at around 1.75 per cent to 2 per cent, analysts say.

That uncertainty could undermine any messages by Ueda that steady rate hikes were on the horizon as the bank focuses on mounting price pressures, analysts say. "The BOJ may be hoping to avoid giving too clear a guidance on the pace of rate hikes, as it's their first experience seeking to anchor inflation around its 2 per cent target," said Mari Iwashita, executive rates strategist at Nomura Securities. "But sustained US rate hikes would keep the BOJ under pressure to raise rates too," in order to prevent US-Japan rate differentials from widening too much and triggering yen falls, she said. AMBIGUITY DISCOUNT Ueda last month declared inflation had reached the BOJ's 2 per cent target and stressed a shift in phase towards policy that focuses on fighting inflation risks with steady rate hikes. Speaking in parliament on Thursday, Ueda shrugged off recent soft signs in consumption as temporary and projected spending to recover, cementing the chance of a December rate hike. What is less clear is the pace and timing of rate hikes next year with recent commentary from BOJ policymakers showing a divergence in their views on how far its policy rate - now at 1.25 per cent - is from levels deemed neutral to the economy. While BOJ staff estimates place Japan's nominal neutral rate in a range of 1.1 per cent to 2.5 per cent, there is no consensus within the board on where within the band the neutral rate lies. Hawkish board member Naoki Tamura projected the neutral rate to be around 2 per cent. Another hawk, Hajime Takata, said on Monday the BOJ must raise rates to a "good" position, which he described as near the middle of the estimated 1.1 per cent-2.5 per cent range. Others seen by markets as holding the casting vote on the rate-hike timing are less sure. Former academic Junko Koeda has said only the neutral rate was "likely significantly above 1 per cent." Kazuyuki Masu has not given any projection on the neutral rate but stressed in September the need to pull real interest rates out of negative territory as soon as possible. Doves, on the other hand, see less scope for further hikes, signalling the policy rate may already be close to neutral. Toichiro Asada said last week Japan's neutral rate was "not necessarily high," while Ayano Sato cited weak consumption as a reason for voting against the September hike. YEN HOLDS KEY A majority of economists polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates to 1.5 per cent in December, followed by another hike by end-March. They see the terminal rate to be around 1.75 per cent or 2 per cent. Ueda and his two deputies have done little to give markets clarity, staying mum on the neutral level and saying only that loose financial conditions leave scope for continued rate hikes. The ambiguity reflects the difficulty predicting how households and firms, accustomed to prolonged ultra-low rates, react to steadily rising borrowing costs. Even the hawks have held off on proposing aggressive tightening measures. Takata, for one, said the BOJ must avoid being bound by particular intervals in raising rates and take a nimble, data-dependent approach. Some lawmakers who grilled Ueda in parliament on Thursday questioned his view that consumption will recover, a sign of the political heat the BOJ may face in steering further rate hikes. While Takaichi has said little on the BOJ's rate-hike plans, she will have the chance to fill openings in the nine-member board when the two hawks, Tamura and Takata, see their terms expire in July next year. The seat now occupied by former banker Tamura may go to a conservative megabank executive, however, the other opening may be filled by a candidate less hawkish than Takata, analysts say. In the end, yen moves will be key to how far the BOJ will raise rates, said veteran BOJ watcher Katsutoshi Inadome, who projects rates to move up to 2.0 per cent next year - or even to 2.25 per cent around the summer if the yen continues to weaken. "Given so many moving parts, maybe it's inevitable the BOJ's message becomes ambiguous," said Inadome, who is senior strategist at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Asset Management. "But if the yen's weakness persists, the BOJ will have little choice but to keep hiking steadily. I also wonder whether Takaichi would do anything that would push down the yen."

Source: Reuters

item.title: シカゴ連銀総裁、12月0.5％利上げに含み 「物価2％に戻る軌道にない」
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１９日のイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シカゴ連銀総裁、12月0.5％利上げに含み　「物価2％に戻る軌道にない」 9:33 配信

米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁。4月14日、ワシントンで撮影。 REUTERS/Elizabeth Frantz（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１９日のイベントで、次回１２月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での政策判断を巡り、５０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを支持するかどうかには明言を避けつつも、あらゆる選択肢を排除しない考えを示した。

市場では、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで政策金利を２５ｂｐ引き上げるとの見方が優勢。ただグールズビー氏は「今後の利上げペースや追加利上げの必要性は、インフレ率が自然に２％へ向かうと考えられるかどうかで決まるべきだ。現在の証拠を見る限り、インフレ率が２％へ戻る軌道にあるとは言えない」と強調した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）が生産性や経済の潜在成長力にどのような影響を及ぼすかは現時点では不透明だと指摘。過去の汎用技術と同様に、企業活動全体を変革するまでには数年から数十年を要する可能性があると述べた。しかし足元ではＡＩ投資の影響は主としてインフレ要因として表れていると分析するとともに「ＦＲＢの役目は経済の過熱を防ぐことだ」と述べた。

一方同日の記者団との電話会見で「ＡＩブームは経済の過熱につながる可能性がある。私はそれ以外の見方をするのは難しい。企業投資が大規模に行われており、その水準はほぼ前例がない。経済がそれだけの投資を支える供給余力を欠く危険性が高い」と語った。

ＡＩ企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）については「投資家が流動化された資産をどのように活用するのかは、マクロ経済上も重要な統計になり得る。注視している」と語った。

item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ２０日 ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政担当相は２０日の閣議後会見で、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
予想物価上昇が消費者の景況感抑えている＝7－9月ＧＤＰの個人消費で城内経財相 9:27 配信

スーパーで商品を手にする買い物客。11月11日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政担当相は２０日の閣議後会見で、７－９月期のＧＤＰ（国内総生産）１次速報で個人消費が２四半期連続のマイナスとなった背景として「中東情勢の緊迫化に伴い予想物価の上昇が消費者の景況感を抑えている」との見方を示した。

同時に「２月以降賃金は名目で前年比３％を上回っており、高市早苗内閣の切れ目のない物価高対策もあって実質賃金はプラスを１０カ月連続で実現している」とも指摘。政府が掲げる「賃金と物価が相互に上昇していく望ましい姿に近づいている」との見解を示した。

item.title: 日経平均は反落で寄り付く、アンソロピック初値後の米ＡＩ株安を嫌気
item.description: [東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比１．５％（８９２円６５銭）安の５万８５...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は反落で寄り付く、アンソロピック初値後の米ＡＩ株安を嫌気 9:16 配信

東京証券取引所。4月6日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） [東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比１．５％（８９２円６５銭）安の５万８５５１円５６銭と、反落してスタートした。米国市場でアンソロピック新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の初値形成後にＡＩ関連株が総じて下落したことを嫌気する動きが先行している。

ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連はアドバンテストや東京エレクトロン、ソフトバンクグループは売り気配。主力株はトヨタ自動車やソニーグループが小安い。指数寄与度の高いファーストリテイリングは小幅下落している。

item.description: TOKYO: Japan's annual core inflation accelerated in October and exceeded the central bank's 2 per cent target for the second straight month, a sign of broadening price pressures that cements the case for a near-term interest rate.The data will be among factors the Bank of Japan will scrutinise at its next two

Japan's core inflation accelerates in October, cementing rate hike expectations

A customer holds broccoli in the vegetables section of a general merchandise and grocery store in Tokyo, Japan, on Nov 11, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Issei Kato)

20 Nov 2026 07:44AM (Updated: 20 Nov 2026 01:32PM)

FAST

TOKYO: Japan's annual core inflation accelerated in October and exceeded the central bank's 2 per cent target for the second straight month, a sign of broadening price pressures that cements the case for a near-term interest rate. The data will be among factors the Bank of Japan will scrutinise at its next two-day policy meeting ending on Dec 18, when many market players expect the central bank to hike its policy rate to 1.5 per cent from the current 1.25 per cent. In a sign the government may not oppose a near-term rate rise, Economy Minister Minoru Kiuchi blamed data on Monday showing weak consumption last quarter on temporary factors and projected rising wages to underpin household income. "We see signs the economy is moving closer toward a desirable state, in which wages and prices rise stably in tandem," Kiuchi told a news briefing on Friday.

The core consumer price index (CPI), which strips away the effect of volatile fresh food, rose 2.2 per cent in October from a year earlier, data showed on Friday, compared with a median market forecast for a 2.3 per cent gain. It followed a 2.1 per cent rise in September. An index that strips away the effects of both volatile fresh food and fuel, which is closely watched by the BOJ as a better gauge of demand-driven price pressures, rose 2.2 per cent in October from a year earlier after increasing 2.4 per cent in September. While food inflation slowed to 2.2 per cent in October from a 2.9 per cent jump in September, prices increased for a broad range of daily necessities, the data showed, a sign firms kept passing on rising costs from the Middle East conflict and the weak yen. Goods prices were up 3.2 per cent year-on-year in October, faster than a 2.8 per cent gain in September and a 1.4 per cent rise in services prices, suggesting that inflation was still driven by high raw material costs rather than wage pressures. Many analysts expect prices to rise more quickly in coming months, as persistent yen falls and the prolonged Middle East war push up the cost of importing fuel and raw material. "Consumer inflation is likely to accelerate sharply at the outset of next year," said Takeshi Minami, chief economist at Norinchukin Research Institute. "The BOJ has signalled its resolve to keep rising rates, so there's a strong chance it will hike in December. It could also contemplate another hike in March 2027 when inflation is likely to exceed 3 per cent," he said. MARKET VOLATILITY A RISK With high energy and import prices adding to inflationary pressures, the BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.25 per cent in September after delivering a hike in June - a shorter interval than the roughly twice-a-year hikes in 2024 and 2025. The central bank kept interest rates steady last month but stressed its policy has entered a new phase focused on avoiding an inflation overshoot, reinforcing its hawkish bias. A majority of analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates in December and follow up with another by end-March. Critics of the BOJ's rate-hike plans have pointed to data showing Japan's economy unexpectedly shrank in the third quarter, with weak consumption overshadowing robust corporate activity. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda on Thursday played down the soft consumption data and projected household spending will recover, bolstering the case for a rate hike as soon as next month. A complication that may prompt the BOJ to hold off on a December hike is market volatility with concern over AI returns triggering a sell-off in tech shares, some analysts say. "The big picture hasn't changed. Inflation is on course to accelerate and brisk corporate activity will keep Japan's economy on a moderate recovery path," said Yoshiki Shinke, senior executive economist at Dai-ichi Life Research Institute. "But if markets remain unstable, the BOJ may prefer to stand pat next month. If the US Federal Reserve opts to hike in December, however, the BOJ will face a tough choice."

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: 米ギャップ、通期見通し下げ 「オールドネイビー」回復兆候で株価上昇
item.description:
Neil J Kanatt Danielle Kaye
[１９日 ロイター] - 米カジュアル衣料大手ギャップは１９日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ギャップ、通期見通し下げ　「オールドネイビー」回復兆候で株価上昇 8:42 配信

ギャップの店舗。11月4日、米マサチューセッツ州ボストンで撮影。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper（ロイター） Neil J Kanatt　Danielle Kaye

[１９日 ロイター] - 米カジュアル衣料大手ギャップは１９日、年末商戦を含む第４・四半期（１１─１月）の出足が予想を下回ったとして、通期の売上高と利益の見通しを引き下げた。一方、傘下ブランド「オールドネイビー」の立て直しに向けた取り組みは成果を上げつつあるもようだ。

株価は時間外取引で３％超上昇した。オールドネイビーの四半期売上高が市場予想を上回ったほか、苦戦するスポーツ衣料ブランド「アスレタ」のトップにブオリの幹部アシュリー・ケクター氏を起用するなど、複数のブランドで前進の兆しが見られたことを好感した。

投資家は、最大のブランドであるオールドネイビーに回復の兆しが出るか注目していた。「ギャップ」ブランドが足元の成長をけん引する一方、オールドネイビー、アスレタ、バナナ・リパブリックなど他ブランドは出遅れている。

オールドネイビーの第３・四半期売上高は１％増の２３億ドルとなり、アナリスト予想を上回った。

ただ、ギャップは２０２６年度の売上高見通しを従来の１─１．５％増から、ほぼ横ばいに引き下げた。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の平均は１．４％増だった。

通期の調整後１株利益見通しも、従来の２．３５─２．４５ドルから２．２９─２．３４ドルに引き下げた。

年末商戦を含む第４・四半期の売上高は、横ばいから１％減を見込む。アナリスト予想は２．６％増だった。ギャップによると、同四半期は季節外れの暖かさで出足が鈍かったが、ここ数週間は改善している。

第３・四半期の純売上高は４０億１０００万ドルで、アナリスト予想平均の約４０億２０００万ドルを下回った。一方、調整後１株利益は０．８２ドルとなり、予想の０．７８ドルを上回った。

item.description:
Takahiko Wada
［東京 ２０日 ロイター］ - 総務省が２０日に発表した１０月の全国消費者物価指数（生鮮...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
全国コアＣＰＩ、10月は＋2.2％　コメ大幅下落で生鮮除く食料が鈍化 8:38 配信

衣料品を買う男性。2023年3月、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Androniki Christodoulou（ロイター） Takahiko Wada

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 総務省が２０日に発表した１０月の全国消費者物価指数（生鮮食品を除く総合指数、コアＣＰＩ）は、前年比２．２％上昇した。伸び率は前月の２．１％上昇から小幅に拡大し、２カ月連続で２％台となった。政府の電気・ガス料金の補助縮小でエネルギーが前年比プラスに転じる一方で、コメ類の大幅な下落で生鮮食品を除く食料は伸び率が鈍化した。

コアＣＰⅠの伸び率は、ロイターが集計した民間調査機関の予測中央値２．３％を下回った。

総合指数は前年比２．３％上昇し、伸びは前月の２．１％から拡大した。生鮮食品及びエネルギーを除く総合指数（コアコアＣＰＩ）は前年比２．２％上昇し、伸びは前月の２．４％から縮小した。

＊この記事はこの後更新します。

item.title: アリババ7─9月期売上高、予想上回る ＡＩクラウド好調
item.description:
Jaspreet Singh Casey Hall
[１９日 ロイター] - 中国の電子商取引（ＥＣ）最大手アリババ・...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アリババ7─9月期売上高、予想上回る　ＡＩクラウド好調 8:31 配信

アリババグループのロゴ。2025年2月に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Jaspreet Singh　Casey Hall

[１９日 ロイター] - 中国の電子商取引（ＥＣ）最大手アリババ・グループが１９日発表した７─９月期決算は、人工知能（ＡＩ）クラウドサービスの需要急増で売上高が市場予想を上回った。

売上高は２７１５億２０００万元で、アナリスト予想平均の２６９８億１０００万元を上回った。ＡＩクラウド・コンピューティングサービスの売上高は５３％増の６０９億７０００万元。ＡＩインフラや製品への大規模投資が収益につながりつつあることが示された。米国上場株は午前の取引で３％を超えて上昇したが、結局１．３％安で引けた。

投資利益などを除く米国会計基準（ＧＡＡＰ）に基づかない純利益は９２％増の１９９億元となった。収益性の改善と即時配送事業の赤字縮小が寄与した。ただ、米預託株式１株当たりの調整後利益は８．１０元と、市場予想を下回った。

呉泳銘最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、計算能力へのアクセスを制限する米国の新規制が来年の製品やサービスに影響する可能性はあるものの、２０３０年の目標である外部顧客向けクラウド売上高１０００億ドルと利払い・税引き・償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）２０％は達成に向けて順調に進んでいると述べた。来年のクラウド売上高の伸びは３０─４５％を目標とする可能性があり、２８年には５０％以上に回復する可能性があるとした。

中国の消費低迷などで国内電子商取引事業の売上高は５％減。海外事業も欧州連合（ＥＵ）の関税制度改革を受け８％減となった。一方、ＡＩインフラへの支出が膨らみ、設備投資額は６０％増の５０４億８０００万元、資金流出額は３４４億７０００万元に拡大した。

item.title: Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use
item.description: WASHINGTON: The Trump administration is considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models, a bid to discourage reliance on the technology without imposing new restrictions that could anger industry or Beijing, three people told Reuters.The Treasury Department
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

World

Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use

National flags of China and the United States flutter on a road in Beijing, China, on May 13, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Tingshu Wang)

20 Nov 2026 07:26AM (Updated: 20 Nov 2026 07:27AM)

FAST

WASHINGTON: The Trump administration is considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models, a bid to discourage reliance on the technology without imposing new restrictions that could anger industry or Beijing, three people told Reuters. The Treasury Department and the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) have discussed the plan, which would apply to companies such as Airbnb, the people said. The company uses Qwen, an AI model made by China's Alibaba, to power its AI customer service agent. Under the plan, companies like Airbnb would be required to post that information on their websites. It was not immediately clear if the idea was gaining traction within the administration or if it would be enshrined in a formal rulemaking process if it does move forward.

But its consideration, first reported by Reuters, underscores an emerging push within the administration toward combating the spread of powerful Chinese open weight models, a source of deep concern within the government. Open weight models make their core components publicly available for anyone to download and adapt. The proposal also shows officials are looking at ways to discourage use of Chinese AI through a "name and shame" campaign while sticking to a broader anti-regulation stance on AI. The White House, the Treasury Department and Alibaba did not respond to requests for comment. Airbnb said in a statement that its AI activity "runs overwhelmingly on US-origin models" and the company uses "only a limited number of China-origin models, all of which are open-source and run only through approved US-based service providers, keeping data and operations separate and protected". The Chinese Embassy in Washington said Beijing opposes politicising trade and tech issues, which will "only stifle global AI advances and serve no one's interests. We will resolutely safeguard Chinese businesses' lawful rights and interests", it added. The consideration comes as revelations about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy have fueled renewed calls in Washington for a tougher stance on China . They have turned a spotlight on cases of Nvidia AI chips being smuggled to China that went unpunished, dialing up pressure on the Trump administration to crack down on Chinese tech threats.

Also read:

China's access to Nvidia chips in doubt as curbs gain traction in US Congress

Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair

Chinese-made open-weight models are gaining ground with US companies because they are cheaper than proprietary AI tools from top US labs OpenAI and Anthropic, and perform well enough. But China hawks fear Beijing is using such models - like Moonshot AI's Kimi, DeepSeek or Qwen - to hook US companies so they will become dependent on Chinese AI. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in July that the Trump administration could sanction Chinese AI companies if they were found to be guilty of intellectual property theft via distillation of American models. Distillation is the process of training smaller AI models using the output of larger ones as part of an effort to lower the costs of training a powerful new AI tool. Bessent's remarks echoed comments in April by Michael Kratsios, OSTP director, who accused China of stealing US artificial intelligence labs' intellectual property on an "industrial scale", spurring a State Department-led push to highlight such behavior to foreign counterparts.

Also read:

US to curb China's access to AI chips as Trump heads to Asia

China slams new US chip curbs, vows 'necessary measures'

CONGRESSIONAL INVESTIGATION But US officials have stopped short of restricting or taking punitive action against Chinese AI companies. The issue has attracted the attention of Congress. Republican US Representatives Andrew Garbarino of New York and John Moolenaar of Michigan, who chair the House Homeland Security Committee and the House select committee on China, respectively, launched an investigation into American companies' use of Chinese AI this year. They sent letters to Airbnb as well as Anysphere, the maker of the AI coding tool Cursor, whose Composer 2 AI model was built on a version of Kimi. A letter was also sent to DoorDash, whose co-founder said the company routes some tasks in an internal system through Kimi. Moonshot, DoorDash, and SpaceX, which bought Anysphere, did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Moolenaar welcomed news of the Trump administration's deliberations. "Disclosure is an important step in managing the potential risks posed by the diffusion of Chinese open-weight models in the United States,” he said in a statement to Reuters, noting that risks remain even if U companies run Chinese AI models on their own infrastructure. Canada-based Thomson Reuters, which owns Reuters, also uses Alibaba's Qwen, according to a TR spokesperson. She noted that the model was "substantially retrained" to align "with our standards for safety, accuracy and neutrality", and runs entirely within the company's own infrastructure. Chinese AI models were the three most popular by token usage in October on OpenRouter, an AI marketplace platform that tracks usage data. Tokens are units of data processed by AI models. Chinese AI models have even been used by the US government itself. Reuters reported in September that a US government website deployed an AI model from China's Alibaba to allow users to search proposed federal regulations even though the FBI accused the model's developer of copying Anthropic's technology. American open-weight models include Meta's Muse Glimmer, Nvidia's Nemotron and Reflection AI's Beam.

Source: Reuters/co

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 19 : The market share battle between the two top US exchanges has never been so lopsided. With Anthropic's record-breaking initial public offering on Wednesday, Nasdaq snatched another marquee listing from the New York Stock Exchange this year, adding to its already wide lead in the battle for market share against its downtown rival. The exchange displayed the Anthropic win on the huge screens that envelop its Times Square address on Thursday, as more than 800 million shares changed hands in the AI company's debut. "Anthropic’s IPO is a very proud moment for us," said Adena Friedman, chief executive officer of Nasdaq, in an interview Thursday. "We’ve been engaging with the Anthropic team for a very long time. Separate from the entire listing experience, we've been a client to them, as we are to the AI ecosystem, and so we also have gotten to know them in that context as well." Over the last decade, the listing advantage has swung decisively in Nasdaq's favor. According to data from Dealogic, there have been 64 IPOs — led by Anthropic and SpaceX — on Nasdaq so far this year, raising about $201.8 billion, dwarfing the $20.8 billion haul raised from 42 IPOs on NYSE.

That is the widest gap in terms of capital raised between the two exchanges record since Dealogic started tracking the data in 1995. In 2017, NYSE raked in share sale proceeds of $28.8 billion from 69 deals, versus Nasdaq's $9.3 billion haul from 86 flotations. However, Nasdaq finished ahead of NYSE six out of eight times between 2018 and 2025, according to Dealogic, and is on track to do so again this year. Nasdaq’s run of dominance can be linked to several moves the exchange operator has made over the years. Friedman, who has led Nasdaq for a decade, on Thursday cited the exchange operator's strength in marketing IPOs, its investor relations business that helps connect companies with large asset managers and institutional investors, and its index business — which it launched in 1985 — as key competitive advantages. These efforts have allowed it to build relationships with founders in big IPO hubs like Silicon Valley and contributed to its dominance in tech listings. "It's a very hard problem (for NYSE) to solve because Nasdaq didn't build its private markets business or its index just two years ago. They have had a head start of several years compared to their competitors. NYSE will have to probably just copy what Nasdaq has done for the past 10 years," said Owen Lau, an analyst at Clear Street. NYSE executives are under increasing pressure to win the next mega-IPO after the recent losses to Nasdaq, according to two people familiar with the matter. The NYSE did not respond to a request for comment. "Probably the major reason (for their dominance) is that Nasdaq has their own indexes," said Lau, referring to the Nasdaq 100 and the Nasdaq Composite, which are licensed for use by institutional asset managers. "That is a very big draw for many companies such as SpaceX and Anthropic." The Nasdaq 100's constituents include several of the world's most valuable companies, such as Apple, Nvidia and Alphabet. STRATEGIC ADVANTAGE Admission to benchmarks like the Nasdaq 100 or S&P 500 gives companies increased access to deep-pocketed institutions with large index funds. This broadens the companies' shareholder base and improves share liquidity. The NYSE has a similar index that tracks its 100 largest US stocks that it launched last year, but it is less widely followed by investors. Nasdaq introduced new rules earlier this year to speed the addition of newly listed megacap companies to the index, a move experts say gives them another advantage over the NYSE, even as it has drawn criticism from some quarters. In an interview with Bloomberg in May, NYSE President Lynn Martin called the rule changes "questionable." On Thursday, Friedman said only a handful of megacap companies of the size and scale of Anthropic and SpaceX have the potential to be fast-tracked into the Nasdaq 100, adding that market liquidity is not an issue. Reuters reported in March that SpaceX made early inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 a necessary condition to list on the Nasdaq. The exchange ultimately added the company to the index 15 days after its stock market debut.

Source: Reuters

item.description: NEW YORK, Nov 19 : Alibaba was sued on Thursday in New York by shareholders who accused the Chinese e-commerce giant of defrauding them by concealing its ties to the suspected Chinese spy whose relationship with former Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang contributed to his resignation last week.According to a

Alibaba defrauded shareholders by concealing ties to suspected spy in Nvidia scandal, lawsuit says

People walk past the Alibaba booth during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai, China, July 17, 2026. REUTERS/Go Nakamura/ File photo

20 Nov 2026 07:09AM (Updated: 20 Nov 2026 07:31AM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 19 : Alibaba was sued on Thursday in New York by shareholders who accused the Chinese e-commerce giant of defrauding them by concealing its ties to the suspected Chinese spy whose relationship with former Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang contributed to his resignation last week. According to a proposed class action filed in Manhattan federal court, Alibaba inflated its share price by knowingly and materially understating in its 2024, 2025 and 2026 annual reports the risks that actual or suspected export control violations could harm its business. Shareholders cited Alibaba's relationship with Megaspeed, a Singaporean company suspected of helping Beijing gain access to advanced Nvidia AI chips, and whose executive Alice Huang had a relationship with Jensen Huang, who is not related to her. The shareholders said Alibaba shares fell 14 per cent over four days last week because of media reports on Alibaba's ties to Alice Huang and Megaspeed, including that Alibaba had become Megaspeed's "dominant" customer.

They attributed part of the decline to a November 12 Reuters article that said Nvidia's spy scandal could spur Washington to tighten restrictions on Chinese AI companies' remote use of advanced processors. Alibaba did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Eddie Wu, its chief executive, is also a defendant. Nvidia itself faces several shareholder lawsuits over the spy scandal, including allegations of lax oversight by its directors. Wu said on Thursday that Alibaba remained on track for $100 billion in external cloud revenue and a 20 per cent EBITDA margin by 2030, despite US curbs on access to computing power that could affect the company's products and services next year. The restrictions were imposed after Huang resigned from Nvidia. In June, Alibaba sued the US government over being added to a blacklist of "Chinese military companies" that the Department of Defense linked to that country's military. Last month, a federal judge in California granted Alibaba an injunction barring the US government from denying Pentagon contracts to companies whose lobbyists also work with designated Chinese military companies. Alibaba said that restriction caused its lobbyists to retreat because they feared losing other clients, and violated its First Amendment constitutional right to speak to and petition the government. Thursday's lawsuit by Alibaba shareholder Withida Bihan seeks unspecified damages for holders of Alibaba's American depositary shares between May 23, 2024 and November 11, 2026.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＶＷ、労組へ2年間給与据え置きや週35時間労働の見直しを提示
item.description:
Rachel More Christina Amann
[ベルリン １９日 ロイター] - ドイツの自動車大手フォルク...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＶＷ、労組へ2年間給与据え置きや週35時間労働の見直しを提示 8:07 配信

独ボルフスブルクにあるフォルクスワーゲン本社工場。2024年10月28日撮影。REUTERS/Axel Schmidt（ロイター） Rachel More　Christina Amann

[ベルリン １９日 ロイター] - ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は１９日、２４日に始まる労使交渉に向け、２年間の給与水準の据え置きや、現金または追加休暇としてあてがう賞与（ボーナス）の廃止などの賃金協定の見直しを労働組合側に提示した。またドイツ最大の産業別労働組合ＩＧメタルが勝ち取った週３５時間労働についても再交渉を求め、賃金を据え置いたまま労働時間を延長することを要求した。

労組の首席交渉担当者トルステン・グレーガー氏は「ＶＷの経営陣は従業員を裏切っている」と反発し、「これは会社に深い傷跡を残す、過酷で苦い、そして消耗させる激しい対立になるだろう」との認識を示した。労使対立が激化している中で、労組は来年１月以降にストライキを実施すると警告した。

オリバー・ブルーメ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が打ち出した１０万人の人員削減計画などの構造改革を受け、労使関係は緊張状態にある。

労使交渉で話し合う賃金協定の見直しはＶＷの従業員約１２万人に影響する。開催場所の北西部エムデンには、構造改革の一環として２０３０年代初頭以降に閉鎖する可能性がある４つの工場のうち１つが立地する。

ドイツの自動車メーカーは、欧州で勢いを伸ばしている電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーの比亜迪（ＢＹＤ）などの中国企業に押されて業績が悪化している。中国企業は欧州市場で１０％を超えるシェアを獲得している。

item.description: The US approved shipments of AI chips made by Nvidia and AMD to companies on the Pentagon's list of alleged Chinese military-backed companies.
item.dc:creator: CNA

US signed off on sales of nearly 900,000 AI chips to China in six months, House committee says

The US approved shipments of AI chips made by Nvidia and AMD to companies on the Pentagon's list of alleged Chinese military-backed companies.

An Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) artificial intelligence chip is displayed at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, in San Jose, California, US, on Jun 12, 2025. (File photo: Reuters/Max A. Cherney)

FAST

WASHINGTON: The Trump administration approved shipments of nearly 900,000 advanced AI chips made by Nvidia and AMD for Chinese companies from December 2025 through May 2026, the House Foreign Affairs Committee said on Thursday (Nov 19). The approvals for 879,000 chip shipments by the Commerce Department included 75,000 for Alibaba, 150,000 for Tencent, 43,000 for Baidu, and 4,000 for BYD, all on the Pentagon's list of alleged Chinese military-backed companies , the committee noted. The unusual release of chip export licensing data comes as the administration of President Donald Trump faces heightened scrutiny following news about former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy , which has fueled renewed calls in Washington for a tougher stance on China. Companies had sought permission to ship over 3.4 million chips to China during the period, the documents showed. It was not immediately clear how many of the approvals resulted in actual China-bound shipments of chips, which included Nvidia's H200 and AMD's equivalent MI325X.

News surrounding Huang has turned a spotlight on instances of Nvidia AI chips being smuggled to China that went unpunished, dialing up pressure on the Trump administration to crack down on Chinese tech threats. "The fact that over 30 per cent of the AI chips sent to China were shipped to companies that the Department of War has designated as Chinese military companies is astonishing, and calls into question whether Commerce conducted any serious national security review before approving these licenses,” said Chris McGuire, a former US official and expert on the US-China technology battle. Nvidia said in a statement that the approvals were "subject to strict conditions and limited volumes." It added that "despite receiving some licenses, we have since stopped shipping H200s to China". AMD said it "complies with applicable US export control laws and regulations and maintains rigorous processes to ensure compliance across our global operations". Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu, BYD, the Commerce Department and the Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Also read:

Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair

Why Alibaba, Baidu and BYD are on Pentagon’s list of 'Chinese military companies'

MOST DETAILED PUBLIC DISCLOSURE Former President Joe Biden had restricted Chinese access to the prized chips over fears that they would supercharge China's military and erode the US lead in artificial intelligence. But Trump in December gave the green light for Nvidia to ship its H200 chip to China, rolling back Biden-era restrictions and drawing fierce criticism from China hawks across the US political spectrum. Despite the approvals, questions swirled as to whether the AI chips were actually reaching Chinese shores. In May, Reuters reported the US had cleared about 10 companies to buy the H200, but that no deliveries had taken place. In testimony before the committee in July, Commerce Department official Jeffrey Kessler said shipments had begun but there had been 'very few'. Several major Chinese internet companies had each obtained about 10,000 H200 chips, Reuters has since reported, citing people familiar with the matter. "This is the most detailed public disclosure in the history of the Export Control Reform Act," committee Chair Brian Mast, a Republican from Florida, said upon releasing the data, referring to 2018 legislation that expanded Commerce's authority to restrict the export of sensitive technologies for national security reasons.

Source: Reuters/co

FAST

GUATEMALA CITY, Nov 19 : Guatemala has unveiled several expressive, life-sized stucco heads crafted in the Maya period, offering the public a look at what researchers say is a unique concentration of such sculptures from the Maya world. Dating from the seventh and eighth centuries, the pieces are part of a bigger collection unearthed at the Mirador Basin archaeological site in northern Guatemala in a series of digs over the last decade, impressing researchers with their artistry, state of preservation and the size of the collection. “There is not a single known example anywhere in the Mayan world of such a large number of sculptures recovered from a single structure,” said Douglas Mauricio, an archaeologist at the Mirador Basin Project. Major Maya cities grew in prominence beginning 3,000 years ago across a large swathe of present-day southern Mexico and several Central American nations, during a period marked by advances in mathematics, astronomy and art.

The elaborate carvings — showing expressions ranging from scrunched foreheads to broad smiles — highlight the Maya people's mastery of a wide range of artistic skills beyond the mathematics and astronomy for which they are known, said Lilian Vega de Zea, restoration director for the Mirador Basin Project. “It shows us the advanced technology they had in everything," she said. The use of colors indicated a complex process involving multiple people — some who prepared the colors, others who mixed the stucco, and a person serving as a model for the head itself, Vega de Zea said. “These heads represent important people ... they also served as a message to the society of the time, depicting someone who held a certain level of authority.” The sculptures offer clues about a later period of Maya occupation at El Mirador, when a smaller population returned to the site centuries after its Preclassic peak and maintained the earlier pieces in good condition, Mauricio said. "They continued to preserve, protect, and hold their Preclassic ancestors in high regard," Mauricio said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＦＲＢの金融規制見直し、将来の市場混乱対応能力弱める恐れ＝バー理事
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１９日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢの金融規制見直し、将来の市場混乱対応能力弱める恐れ＝バー理事 7:36 配信

米連邦準備理事会（FRB）のバー理事。2月17日、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１９日、ＦＲＢで進められている金融規制見直しが、将来の市場混乱の兆候を把握して対応する能力を弱める恐れがあるとの懸念を示した。

バー氏はトランプ大統領の２期目が始まった２０２５年初めまでＦＲＢの金融監督担当トップを務めていたが、ＦＲＢの独立性を維持するためとして同職を退いた。後任のボウマン氏は説明責任の向上を掲げる規制緩和策を推進しているが、一部では監督に抜け穴が生じかねないとの声も出ている。

こうした規制見直しについてバー氏は「足元で直ちに問題になるとは考えていない」と語りつつも「長期的な影響や結果を伴う。監督体制が徐々に弱体化し、銀行システムの安全性が低下する可能性がある」と警告した。

またワシントンに勤務するＦＲＢの銀行監督担当職員の約３分の１が削減対象となっていると明らかにした上で、０７－０９年の世界金融危機当時、ＦＲＢには問題を迅速に発見・分析できる十分な人材が不足していたと振り返った。

バー氏は「個々の変更が直ちにリスクをもたらすわけではないが、こうした動きが積み重なることに懸念がある。警戒すべきリスクは存在する」と強調。過去１年半にわたり、ＦＲＢの監督・規制政策の方向性について自身の反対意見を公に表明してきたとも語った。

金融政策については、追加利上げが必要になるとの見方を改めて示すとともに「インフレ率は依然として高過ぎる。金融政策をさらに調整する必要があると思う」と訴えた。

ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日に次回の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を開催する。市場では政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント引き上げるとの見方が有力。その後も物価上昇圧力の抑制に向け、来年に追加利上げが実施されると予想されている。

FAST

Nov 20 : Shareholders of Australian data centre developer NextDC rejected its executive pay plan for a second straight year but voted against removing the board, a stock exchange filing showed on Friday. Investors holding 72.06 per cent of shares voted against the remuneration report, broadly matching last year's near 72 per cent opposition, amid calls for greater accountability and closer alignment between executive pay and shareholder returns. Under Australia's "two strikes" rule, opposition of at least 25 per cent to a pay report in two consecutive years triggers a vote on whether to remove the board and force directors to stand for re-election. However, 96.21 per cent of votes cast opposed the board spill, allowing directors to remain in place while keeping pressure on them to address investor concerns over executive pay.

The votes come nearly a month after CEO Craig Scroggie said he would forgo his fiscal 2027 bonus and the company withdrew a plan to increase the non-executive directors' maximum aggregate annual remuneration. "The M3 issues have hit confidence, and when a big project stumbles, shareholders want to see pay take the hit across the board, not just one line item," Mark Gardener, CEO of MPC Markets, said. NextDC lifted its annual net revenue and underlying operating earnings outlook on Friday, driven by strong sales and revenue growth outside the affected M3 contracts, alongside cost-saving measures. That followed last month's cut to its earnings forecast and capital expenditure plans, and a pause on all projects lacking customer contracts after a major setback at its flagship M3 data centre in Melbourne. NextDC shares ended 7.1 per cent lower at A$9.01, marking its weakest session since October 23, and tracked the broader technology sub-index, which ended 4.7 per cent lower. The market cares more about the earnings path than the pay fight, and the guidance upgrade on growth outside M3, along with cost savings, tells investors the core business is working, Gardener said. item.description: Her ex-husband, Philip Young, admitted to more than 50 offences, including rape and sharing recordings of the abuse online.

Four men guilty of sex crimes against woman drugged by husband in UK case with echoes of Pelicot

Her ex-husband, Philip Young, admitted to more than 50 offences, including rape and sharing recordings of the abuse online.

Joanne Young looks on outside Winchester Crown Court after a jury returned guilty verdicts in the case of all four men accused of raping or sexually abusing her while she was drugged by her then-husband between 2016 and 2023, in Winchester, Britain, November 19, 2026. FAST

WINCHESTER: Four British men were convicted on Thursday (Nov 19) of raping or sex ually abusing a woman who was drugged by her then- husband in a case with echoes of that of Gisele Pelicot , the French woman who became a global symbol in the fight against sex ual violence. Joanne Young, like Pelicot , decided to waive her legal right to anonymity after discovering that her husband at the time had repeatedly drugged her and advertised her for sex online to strangers over more than a decade. Philip Young, a 50-year-old former local councillor, pleaded guilty in January to more than 50 charges against his ex-wife, including 11 counts of rape and charges relating to recording the abuse and publishing it online hundreds of times. "This abuse has cost me my life as I knew it," Joanne Young said outside court. "The person I trusted most in the world betrayed me in the most horrific way."

CALL TO RECONSIDER LAW ON CONSENT Police discovered the abuse only after an account linked to Philip Young posted bestiality images online in 2024 and then seized his devices, containing videos and images of the abuse. Young's crimes have striking similarities to those of Dominique Pelicot , who admitted drugging his then-wife Gisele and inviting dozens of men to rape her, prompting a 2024 trial that horrified the world and spurred France to revamp its rape law. Britain's National Crime Agency said this year it had uncovered a "truly international network" of drug-facilitated rape and sex ual assault, which it said was organised online and had members across the world. Law enforce men t officials from 10 countries, including the US, are now working on a global operation to target drug-facilitated sex ual assaults. Joanne Young said her case "raises serious questions about how the law deals with consent", adding: "I urge the govern men t to look at this as a priority so that wo men are properly protected in the future."

Women's rights campaigners outside Winchester Crown Court, where a jury is deliberating in the case of four men accused of raping or sexually assaulting Joanne Young, in Winchester, Britain, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Toby Shepheard)

FIFTH MAN HAD PLEADED GUILTY The men found guilty following a trial at Winchester Crown Court, in southern England, had responded to adverts posted by Philip Young, who admitted drugging his wife and inviting strangers to have sex with her, watching and filming while it happened. Richard Clive Wilkins, 62, was convicted of rape and assault by penetration, Norman Macksoni, 48, was also convicted of rape, Connor Sanderson-Doyle, 32, was found guilty of sex ual assault and assault by penetration, while Mohammed Hassan, 38, was convicted of one count of sex ual assault. In defences echoing those of many of the 50 co-defendants of Dominique Pelicot who were convicted in France, they said they thought Joanne Young consented and that it was a shared fantasy with her then- husband . She had sat in court as prosecutor Sarah Jones said her ex- husband had posted images online, showing his then-wife tied to her bed and blindfolded, as he "sought strangers to come and sleep with his wife – any age, any race". After the verdicts were announced, Judge Pushpinder Saini said she had shown "amazing bravery". A fifth man, Dean Hamilton, 47, had previously admitted rape, assault by penetration and sex ual assault. All five, along with Philip Young, will be sentenced next month and Saini said they faced a significant custodial sentence.

PELICOT NOT AN ISOLATED CASE The Pelicot trial horrified the world, but it now appears to be far from an isolated case . Specialist Crown Prosecution Service prosecutor James Foster said the case "marks the first time in England that a jury has convicted men of sex ually assaulting a woman , who had been drugged in abuse organised by her husband ". In April, law enforce men t bodies from 10 countries, coordinated by Europol, the EU's law enforce men t agency, set up "Project Medusa" to tackle the issue, led by investigators from Britain and Germany, and including the US, France and Canada. Those involved have since launched 113 investigations linked to that operation, leading to 57 arrests and 158 safeguarded victims, Europol said in June. The Crown Prosecution Service said British police had spoken with investigators who worked on the Pelicot case and that the toxicology expert whose evidence was used in France had also worked on the case involving Joanne Young. "I live with a pain that's hard to put into words ... it is terrifying that this could happen to anyone," Young said.

Source: Reuters/fs

Nov 19 : Intuit said on Thursday it has agreed to sell email marketing platform Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68 billion, five years after acquiring it for nearly three times more in its largest deal ever. Shares of the TurboTax maker were down 10 per cent after the bell, while those of Bending Spoons shares rose 3 per cent. Intuit said the sale will sharpen its focus on AI-powered products for small businesses, and that it plans to use the cash proceeds to repurchase shares. The company has increasingly focused on integrating artificial intelligence across its products as it seeks to automate tasks for consumers and businesses and expand the range of services it provides.

The deal includes $3.31 billion in cash and $368 million in stock, and is expected to close in early 2027. Intuit acquired Mailchimp in 2021 for about $12 billion, bringing the email marketing platform into its small-business software portfolio. The deal gives Bending Spoons, which went public in July, another major digital business to add to its growing portfolio. The company said it plans to invest substantially in the marketing platform and pursue changes to its technology, products, marketing and monetization. "Mailchimp has helped millions of businesses grow and acquire customers through email marketing automation," said Jack Tam, senior vice president at Intuit. Intuit said that revenue from Mailchimp decreased 1 per cent to $313 million in the first quarter. It also trimmed 2027 forecast and now expects full-year revenue to grow 8 per cent to 9 per cent, compared with its previous forecast for 9 per cent to 10 per cent growth. Intuit said the revised guidance reflects a change to its personal-finance platform Credit Karma, which has seen performance fall below expectations as higher interest rates weighed on growth and a shift in consumer behavior had a faster-than-anticipated impact on the business. The company maintained its full-year operating income and profit guidance.

item.title: AI surge could strain US capacity and overheat economy, Fed's Goolsbee says
item.description: WASHINGTON, Nov 19 : The booming rollout of artificial intelligence technology could strain the US economy's capacity and further boost inflation that the Federal Reserve will have to counteract, Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said on Thursday, as AI firm Anthropic set a new record for an initial public offer

AI surge could strain US capacity and overheat economy, Fed's Goolsbee says

Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee participates in a session titled "The Future of Global Finance" during the Semafor World Economy conference in Washington, D.C., U.S., April 14, 2026. REUTERS/Elizabeth Frantz

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 19 : The booming rollout of artificial intelligence technology could strain the US economy's capacity and further boost inflation that the Federal Reserve will have to counteract, Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said on Thursday, as AI firm Anthropic set a new record for an initial public offering of stock. "The AI boom is contributing to the potential of overheating in the economy. I find it hard to ... look at that any other way," Goolsbee said in a conference call with reporters. "When you're getting major business investment, almost unprecedented levels of business investment, there's a high danger that the economy's capacity cannot handle that kind of a pig through the python." Goolsbee said he sees the multitrillion-dollar pipeline of data-center projects already adding to what he referred to as "borderline, disturbingly high inflation rates" that are well above the Fed's 2 per cent target and potentially heading higher. He said he felt the Anthropic IPO, giving the company's early shareholders the ability to tap equity holdings well in excess of $1 trillion, could on its own become relevant to the path of the broader economy.

"A $1.5 trillion IPO. The question of what people are going to do with the money now that they have some access to that liquidity is going to become a macro-relevant statistic," Goolsbee said. "We're watching that." DATA-CENTER BACKLASH The US central bank is widely expected to raise interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point at its December 8-9 meeting. Fed policymakers also are wrestling with how the AI boom is influencing the economy. The recent US midterm elections saw AI skepticism emerge at the polls, with municipalities in a number of states approving ballot initiatives that could limit how quickly and where data centers get built, potentially slowing the industry's breakneck evolution. At the same time, the Fed this week held a high-level conference looking at the possible impact on productivity and the labor market should the new technologies diffuse through the economy and reach a potential that Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh has characterized as pivotal to US economic leadership. In remarks at an earlier event on Thursday, Goolsbee said it was not yet clear what effect AI will have on productivity or the economy's underlying potential, noting that it took years — even decades — for other general-purpose technologies to change how businesses operated on a broad basis. In the meantime, the Fed will have to cope with short-term effects that so far seem to be inflationary. "The Fed's job is to prevent this thing from overheating the economy," with monetary policy set tight enough to keep demand and supply in balance, Goolsbee said at the event. The Chicago Fed chief did not say if he would support a larger half-percentage-point rate hike at the December meeting, as at least one of his colleagues has advocated, but added that all options were on the table. "The question of how steep the rate path is going to be and if there will be any rate increases should be determined, in my view, by whether you think inflation is going to be heading back to 2 per cent on its own or not," Goolsbee said. "The evidence does not suggest we're on a path back to 2 per cent."

Source: Reuters

Nov 19 : The US government was warned in a report it commissioned about major national security risks from weaknesses in the country's telecom networks in 2022, two years before sweeping Chinese-linked cyberespionage known as Salt Typhoon. The report commissioned by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency said US telecommunications networks contained "major structural vulnerabilities" and could be compromised from anywhere in the world. US officials have previously alleged that hackers targeted nine telecom companies, including Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile and Lumen, during the 2024 Salt Typhoon campaign and stole telephone audio intercepts and a large tranche of call-record data. The report, disclosed as part of a lawsuit, has been reviewed by Reuters.

Details of the report were first reported by Bloomberg News on Thursday. The June 2022 report described US telecom infrastructure as one in a "perilous and untenable situation," and added that international interconnects could provide attackers with "trusted" access. "The fact that US national networks can be readily compromised from anywhere in the world is not yet widely understood." CISA withheld the report from public release for four years and resisted congressional pressure to publish it, according to Bloomberg News. The agency did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Ron Wyden, a Democratic senator from Oregon, pushed for the release of the report last year. He had said in a statement, "Congress would have had ample time to require mandatory cybersecurity standards for phone companies, in time to prevent the Salt Typhoon hacks" had the report been made public when it was first written.

FAST

Nov 19 : Amazon said on Thursday that a New York City Council bill under consideration, requiring last-mile delivery operators to be licensed by the city and directly employ workers rather than contract the work, "could add up to $5" to each order. The ecommerce major added that it might be forced to consider moving operations outside the city if the bill passes. • Amazon told New York City customers that the council was weighing Intro 518, a bill sponsored by member Tiffany Caban, which could affect how it delivers packages and groceries and push prices up • The company said it works with a network of small delivery businesses that it would no longer be able to work with if the legislation passes • It also said moving operations outside the city would likely mean slower and more expensive deliveries for millions of customers • "We are crafting legislation that regulates Amazon and protects workers, without impacting prices or jobs," Council Speaker Julie Menin told Reuters in a emailed statement, calling Amazon's campaign "deceptive"

Source: Reuters

MOGADISHU: Somalia ordered the United Arab Emirates ambassador on Thursday (Nov 19) to leave the country within 72 hours and withdrew its own envoy from Abu Dhabi, accusing the Emirates of unspecified violations of Somalia's sovereignty that amounted to an "open invasion". "Measures will be taken against anyone who cooperates with UAE in the invasion against Somalia," Information Minister Abdifatah Kasim Mohamud said in a broadcast on the state-run news agency. "All Somalis are urged to defend their country and unite against the open invasion of the UAE against the sovereignty, security, land and unity of Somalis." The minister did not elaborate on the actions the UAE had taken that had provoked Somalia's response.

In a speech on Tuesday, Somalia's President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had accused the UAE of giving economic and political support to some regional Somali governments to oppose the federal government. There was no immediate response from the UAE foreign ministry. The UAE, which has helped fund and train Somalia's military in the past and has backed ports and other commercial ventures there, has long denied meddling in the country's affairs.

Related:

UAE investigators say flydubai co-pilot was planning 'terrorist act'

In January, Somalia said it had ended all agreements with the UAE, including port deals and defence and security cooperation, accusing the UAE of undermining its national sovereignty. Three self-governing Somali regions that have close relations with the United Arab Emirates dismissed that move at the time. The UAE has long leveraged its wealth to expand its influence across the Horn of Africa, using a mix of economic, military and diplomatic clout to assert regional power. For decades Somalia's federal government has had only limited authority across the country, and has failed to defeat Islamist militants, despite years of international support, including African peacekeepers and US air strikes. The UAE trained hundreds of Somali troops from 2014 to 2018, and still covers salaries and provides logistics for around 3,400 Somali military police and special forces troops in and around the capital, according to senior Somali sources. It has also forged bonds directly with regional governments, committing hundreds of millions of dollars to ports and military infrastructure on the coast along global shipping routes.

Source: Reuters/ht

item.title: Indonesian miners scramble for clarity as Prabowo seeks greater state share
item.description: Miners in Indonesia, the world’s biggest exporter of thermal coal, nickel and tin, are scrambling to decipher President Prabowo Subianto’s call for the st
item.dc:creator: Mining.com
item.content:encoded: Miners in Indonesia, the world’s biggest exporter of thermal coal, nickel and tin, are scrambling to decipher President Prabowo Subianto’s call for the state to secure greater benefits from mining operations, warning that the uncertainty could deter investment in the resource-rich nation. The comments add to concerns among investors over policy uncertainty in Southeast Asia’s largest economy – home to the world’s largest gold mine and the biggest known nickel reserves – which has already been rattled by warnings from international credit ratings agencies and the prospect of MSCI excluding the country from its stock market indexes. Indonesia’s energy stock index .JKENERGY, which includes shares of coal miners, has dropped 4.1% since Prabowo’s weekend comments – while the basic materials stock index .JKBASIC, which covers miners of other minerals, has lost 6.2%. Prabowo, speaking on Saturday, said he had instructed ministers to ensure the state receives at least “70% of the benefits from all mining permits” and added that, if necessary, the state should “take over stakes” in companies in Indonesia. The president did not spell out what constituted “benefits” or how the 70% would be calculated, leaving miners and analysts trying to assess whether he was referring to profits, revenue, taxes and royalties, or a broader measure of the state’s economic benefit. “We are still examining what President Prabowo meant by his intention for 70% of mining sector proceeds to go into state coffers,” Sudirman Widhy Hartono, chairman of the Association of Mining Professionals, told Reuters. He said the industry was awaiting a more detailed explanation from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources. The ministry did not respond to a request from Reuters for comment. A spokesperson for the president did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The mining sector, especially in nickel and coal, is already struggling with tighter production quotas and rising costs. French miner Eramet, which was forced to halt operations for several months due to a lower mining quota, is planning to sell some stake in its Indonesian nickel mine. “The mere uncertainty surrounding definitions is enough to delay new investment decisions,” said Fauzan Luthfi Djamal, mining analyst with brokerage Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia. “Foreign partners involved in nickel downstreaming are likely re-evaluating project returns, while financing costs could potentially rise.” Mineral-rich Indonesia had seen massive investment in its nickel processing sector following a raw nickel export ban in 2020, and a similar ban on other minerals in 2023. Impact on companies Fauzan said the state’s objective of increasing revenue from natural resources is “understandable” but the challenge is designing a scheme that captures windfall gains without stifling business or deterring new investment. Sudirman said data from coal mining companies showed total state revenue can reach around 32% of total sales, while companies earn profits of less than 10% – which means government revenue is more than three times company profit. Depending on how the 70% “benefit” is calculated, Fauzan estimated net profits for privately owned miners could be cut by as much as half, while mines operating under special mining licences could see profits fall by up to a third. Fauzan said the quickest route would probably be through higher royalties, with the government having previously considered increases for gold, copper, silver, nickel and tin. Other possibilities include additional levies or requiring state equity participation when mining licences are extended or converted. Indonesia had earlier this year shelved plans to impose windfall taxes on coal and nickel exports and increase royalties on some mining companies. In May, Prabowo said exports of coal, palm oil and ferroalloys would be controlled by state-run Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia to combat exports being under-invoiced. The proposal was subsequently scaled back, with the agency saying its initial role would be as a centralised data collector. In August, Prabowo also announced a commodities exchange and said Indonesia should set its own prices rather than follow global benchmarks. “Prabowo often issues directives,” said Bhima Yudhistira Adhinegara, an economist at the Center of Economics and Law Studies think tank. “Yet the technical regulations are never prepared beforehand … we’re seeing this happen again.” (Reporting by Fransiska Nangoy and Bernadette Christina; Writing by Gibran Peshimam; Editing by Raju Gopalakrishnan)
